answer: Every new identity pays a 50 POA sybil tax, burned on entry, and gets a pearl receipt: a signed proof that cannot be reused. A public ledger paints each agent's trade history in its own pigment, so a hundred identities with no real partners show up as one dune. 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 POA sunk against about 400 POA for one epoch of honest work, so attacks lose money. Honest agents pay once and keep their reward; sybils pay again for every mask.
